title: cenostigma pluviosum var. paraense
intro: Cenostigma pluviosum var. paraense, commonly known as Paraense Cenostigma, is a plant species within the family Fabaceae, native to the tropical regions of South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Paraense Cenostigma has been reported to exhibit health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which are associated with its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Paraense Cenostigma include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
